name: (09) Obfuscate — 3 Advanced — Confusion of the Eye

system.description:
An elaboration of Mask of a Thousand Faces turned upon someone else: you make a victim perceive one other person as an entirely different individual — the Sabbat archbishop as a mortal janitor, or a despised Anarch as a coveted primogen. The victim hears whatever the masked person actually says but unconsciously explains away every inconsistency.

Spend one Willpower Trait. Against an unwilling target you must win a Mental Challenge (retest Stealth); the illusion then holds for up to 24 hours. The victim rationalises away most evidence of the deception and grows hard to convince — even angry — if the masked person openly insists on their true identity, which grants the victim a chance to shake off the effect.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
